subject.title: [Feature] Control UI: Support channel-based session view toggle

question: Should the Control UI channel-view work stop at grouped/separated session navigation first, or also add a merged cross-channel timeline now?
rationale: Current main provides channel grouping only; a true merged timeline needs explicit privacy, transcript aggregation, routing, and possibly Gateway protocol semantics that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Separated sessions first
options.body: Build on the current Sessions table channel metadata with channel tabs or filters while leaving merged-timeline semantics for a later design decision.

options.title: Full merged timeline design
options.body: Define the Gateway aggregation, privacy, and reply-routing contract before adding a UI toggle that mixes channel transcripts.

options.title: Route to broader workspace
options.body: Treat #80901 as the primary sessions workspace design and keep this issue as the channel-specific requirement within that broader effort.

recommendation.title: Separated sessions first
recommendation.body: Build on the current Sessions table channel metadata with channel tabs or filters while leaving merged-timeline semantics for a later design decision.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the current merged Control UI session grouping and channel categorization groundwork in PR #100262.
